name: Rei
source:
A third year student from St. Marian Academy in the same class as Miho. She saved Yasuo when he was being attacked by some drunkards.
She is the only one that isn't a prostitute when meeting Yasuo for the first time and since she has no boyfriend she is still a virgin.
